title: ナリタブライアン登場！

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sooo… thirsty.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: My lips are dry, puckered and flaky. Yet, even in such a state, my body continues to breathe. It longs to be quenched.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And that is an act of survival… even if it causes me to thirst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hence, I continue to fill my lungs with air, in hopes that one day… I'll be sated.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Come to Tracen Academy. It may just satisfy that hunger of yours.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: My desire to run—to survive.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …The time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, Narita Brian and I are about to enter the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A stupid question.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go warm up first. I'll see you at the track in a bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By track, I'm guessing she means the training track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get ready quickly and follow her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By the time I get my stuff together and step out into the hallway, she's already gone.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: That must be the trainer working with Brian.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: I hear Brian's finally making her debut. Her sister, Biwa Hayahide, has been performing well in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: I hear she may have the potential to even surpass her sister. She could be the Triple Crown Champion—even outperforming Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Intriguing… She seems to be at the center of everyone's attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Symboli Rudolf—the renowned Tracen Academy student council president. She's a prestigious figure, being a Triple Crown Champion and the object of everyone's admiration.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian. She's capable of creating a one-of-a-kind future for herself through her running. It's for that reason that I've appointed her vice president.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I hear she's already amassed some enthusiastic fans. There are even those looking to compare my records with her yet-to-be-seen ones.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That only shows how high everyone's expectations are—my own included.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm very much looking forward to seeing the kind of runner you will guide Brian to be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And what Brian will hold on to as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Too slow.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gah, no way!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo… Engine… En… gine… puuushhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I warmed up. …With a race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If it doesn't get my blood pumping, it's meaningless. That's why I wanted a partner for my warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But it's not enough… I'm not satiated.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Any volunteers?

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: (Yikes!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No one?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you sure you still want to race her? Twin Turbo is the third one she's beaten.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: N-no way! I can't run with someone like that. I'm scared…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Why don't we move on to training?
Why don't we move on to training?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch… How dull. It's only a race if you have an opponent.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Hmph.
choice_data_list: Once you make your debut, you'll have more than enough opponents to race.
Once you make your debut, you'll have more than enough opponents to race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Because it's the Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Thaaat's right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hah! We're not just gonna let things finish like this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Hishi Amazon—dorm leader of Miho Dormitory. She's known for her strength and generosity, and is often called the Queen of the Amazons.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian, come here a sec! Let's do one lap around the turf track, you and me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll make you taste the bitterness of defeat!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Oh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Color me interested!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: We will… after we're finished!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ha… Haha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A taste of the Twinkle Series… I'm going to savor it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so begins my time with Narita Brian, the racer eager to run to the ends of the earth.
